summary.text: A 26-year-old pregnant woman had diarrhea from October 26, 2022, with mucus and bloody stools, partly improved by a single cefdinir capsule and not improved by nine days of cephalosporin treatment. Colonoscopy on November 21, 2022 showed punctate lesions and flaky ulcers in the sigmoid colon, and biopsies showed active chronic enteritis.

On December 8, 2022, at nine weeks and five days of gestation, PCR identified ribotype 027 C. difficile and the diagnosis was ribotype 027 CDI; other blood, liver, kidney and culture tests were normal and she had taken doxycycline for acne in July 2022.

She received washed microbiota transplantation by enema over three consecutive days without antibiotics, the diarrhea disappeared after the second infusion, and PCR was negative one month later. She gave birth by cesarean section on July 4, 2023, and during two years of follow-up had no diarrhea, no adverse events, and the baby showed normal growth and development.
